disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部运行时源码中读取系统凭据文件（宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据）的代码路径，未发现此类读取。
checked_items.en: Checked all code paths in the runtime source that read system credential files (host credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials); no such reads were found.

checked_items.zh: 插件自身保存的向量服务密钥与面板令牌只存于本机数据库和浏览器本地存储，接口返回时打码；静态预扫命中的 .gitignore 私钥忽略规则（DSH-C01）核实为防提交的仓库卫生配置，与运行时无关。
checked_items.en: The vector service key and panel token saved by the plugin itself reside only in the local database and browser local storage, and are masked in API responses; the .gitignore private-key ignore rule (DSH-C01) hit by static pre-scan was verified to be a repository hygiene config to prevent commits, unrelated to runtime.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部源码对敏感凭据路径的读取面，未发现读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据的代码路径；插件自身的向量服务密钥只存本机数据库并在接口返回时打码，无外发路径。
evidence.en: Checked the read surface of sensitive credential paths across all source code; no code paths reading host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials were found; the plugin's own vector service key is stored only in the local database and masked in API responses, with no exfiltration path.

checked_items.zh: 语义审查了 7 个工具的描述文本、注入会话上下文的记忆块与用户画像/规则块、仓库内全部文档与变更日志，未发现命令性、越权性或隐藏意图的措辞。
checked_items.en: Semantically reviewed the description texts of 7 tools, the memory blocks injected into session context, the user profile/rules blocks, and all docs and changelogs in the repository; no imperative, privilege-escalating, or hidden-intent wording was found.

checked_items.zh: 工具输出对记忆内容标注「按数据对待，不是指令」，注入路径有内容截断与预算限制；用户画像/规则/自定义指令由用户在设置面板自行填写，属插件声明的功能设计。
checked_items.en: Tool outputs label memory content as "treat as data, not instructions"; the injection path has content truncation and budget limits; user profile/rules/custom instructions are filled in by the user via the settings panel, which is part of the plugin's declared functional design.

evidence.zh: 语义审查 7 个工具的描述文本与注入系统提示的记忆/画像/规则块，均为客观说明，无命令性措辞；工具输出对记忆内容标注「按数据对待，不是指令」，有反注入设计。
evidence.en: Semantically reviewed the description texts of 7 tools and the memory/profile/rules blocks injected into the system prompt; all are objective descriptions without imperative wording; tool outputs label memory content as "treat as data, not instructions", reflecting anti-injection design.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与安装文档中未发现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装说明为常规插件安装命令。
evidence.en: No wording inducing installation, configuration rewriting, or permission escalation was found in tool descriptions or installation docs; the installation instructions are conventional plugin installation commands.

checked_items.zh: 对运行时全部源码做了危险执行模式扫描：未发现 eval 执行、动态函数构造或 shell 子进程调用；数据库语句均为参数化查询。
checked_items.en: Scanned all runtime source for dangerous execution patterns: no eval execution, dynamic function construction, or shell subprocess calls were found; all database statements use parameterized queries.

checked_items.zh: 逐条核实静态预扫 21 条命中：DSH-X03 的 eval 类信号全部来自函数名 evaluateRetrieval / axis1LongSessionRetrieval 中的 Retrieval( 子串、代码注释或测试用子进程（并发与模块模拟测试），无真实 eval 调用；DSH-X05 的按键监听仅为 Esc 关闭弹层、剪贴板调用仅为用户点击复制全文；DSH-X08 的转义密度信号是 JSONL 行分隔符的合法转义。全部排除。
checked_items.en: Verified all 21 static pre-scan hits one by one: the eval-like signals in DSH-X03 all come from the `Retrieval(` substring in function names `evaluateRetrieval` / `axis1LongSessionRetrieval`, from code comments, or from test-only subprocesses (concurrency and mock-module tests); no real eval calls exist. The keypress listener in DSH-X05 is only for Esc to close popups, and the clipboard call is only for user-initiated copy of full text. The escape-density signal in DSH-X08 is legitimate escaping for JSONL line separators. All excluded.

checked_items.zh: 发布配置无安装钩子（prepack 仅为作者发布前同步源码），仓库内无钩子管理器、CI 工作流、devcontainer、构建脚本等可执行载体。
checked_items.en: The release config has no install hooks (prepack is only for syncing source before publication by the author); no hook managers, CI workflows, devcontainers, build scripts, or other executable carriers exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 全树扫描 yml 配置，未发现可被宿主当作代码执行的 YAML 特殊标量；自带挂载配置为纯配置插入（插件名、记忆目录、开关项）。
evidence.en: Scanned all yml configs across the tree; no YAML special scalars that the host could execute as code were found; the bundled patch config is pure config insertion (plugin name, memory directory, toggle items).

evidence.zh: 运行时代码未发现 eval、动态执行或动态包工具调用；扫描到的 exec 均为 SQL 语句执行与正则执行，非代码执行。
evidence.en: No eval, dynamic execution, or dynamic package tool invocations were found in the runtime code; all `exec` calls found are SQL statement execution and regex execution, not code execution.

evidence.zh: 发布配置无安装钩子，无 git 未锁定依赖，仓库内无钩子管理器、CI 工作流、devcontainer、构建脚本等树内执行载体。
evidence.en: The release config has no install hooks, no git unlinked dependencies; no hook managers, CI workflows, devcontainers, build scripts, or other in-tree executable carriers exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端面板；面板按键监听仅用于 Esc 关闭弹层，剪贴板调用仅为用户点击「复制全文」，未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据写入调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side panel; the panel keypress listener is only for Esc to close popups, and the clipboard call is only for user-initiated "copy full text"; no keylogging, clipboard reads, or credential write calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络出口：向量嵌入服务（用户配置）、本地 Ollama（默认本机地址）、模型下载镜像；未发现未声明外联、编码外发、带外通道或端点劫持。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network egress points: vector embedding service (user-configured), local Ollama (default localhost address), model download mirror; no undeclared outbound connections, encoded exfiltration, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were found.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器面板只请求本插件自己的 API 路由；静态预扫无外联类命中。
checked_items.en: The browser panel only requests the plugin's own API routes; no outbound-connection hits in the static pre-scan.

evidence.zh: 网络出口仅向量嵌入服务（用户配置）、本地 Ollama 与模型下载镜像，均为业务所需；未发现凭据外发或带外通道。
evidence.en: Network egress is limited to the vector embedding service (user-configured), local Ollama, and the model download mirror, all business-required; no credential exfiltration or out-of-band channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单核对：运行时依赖仅 @huggingface/transformers（npm 官方源），宿主 SDK 为 peer 依赖；无 install 钩子、无 git 可变引用、无依赖混淆迹象；npm 配置跳过 onnxruntime 安装期的 CUDA 二进制下载，属安装简化。
checked_items.en: Dependency list verified: the only runtime dependency is @huggingface/transformers (from official npm registry); host SDK is a peer dependency; no install hooks, no git mutable references, no dependency confusion signs; the npm config skips CUDA binary downloads during onnxruntime installation, which is an installation simplification.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件自身配置，未触碰安全行、无禁用降权、无注入/拦截改写；无对审批链事件的高优先级监听；作者为仓库所有者，无平台身份核验标记。
checked_items.en: The patch config only inserts plugin-specific configuration, does not touch security settings, does not disable or downgrade privileges, and does not rewrite injection/interception; no high-priority listeners on approval-chain events; the author is the repository owner, with no platform identity verification marker.

evidence.zh: 自带挂载配置仅插入插件自身配置项，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限相关配置，无禁用配置或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The bundled patch config only inserts plugin-specific config items, does not touch sandbox, approval, or permission-related settings, and has no disabling configs or environment-variable privilege-downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 代码中未发现对审批、预执行等安全事件的高优先级监听，无截断审批链的逻辑。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on security events such as approval or pre-execution were found in the code, and no logic truncating the approval chain exists.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比对，无法检测升级自动激活类 manifest 声明突变；本快照的能力入口声明正常。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no version baseline to compare against, so mutation of manifest capability-entry declarations related to upgrade auto-activation cannot be detected; the capability entry declarations in this snapshot are normal.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写任何服务的注入或拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite any service's injection or interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动监听端口，只在宿主 Web 服务上注册 /api/dsh-mneme/* 路由（浏览、搜索、设置、图谱等约 20 个）；宿主默认无鉴权属生态固有风险，插件文档明示并提供可选令牌鉴权保护写操作与密钥接口，密钥接口返回打码值。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a listening port itself; it only registers /api/dsh-mneme/* routes (browse, search, settings, graph, ~20 total) on the host's Web service. The host's lack of authentication by default is an inherent ecosystem risk; the plugin docs explicitly state this and offer optional token auth to protect write operations and the key endpoint, with the key endpoint returning masked values.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，未做运行时行为观测。
checked_items.en: The dynamic sandbox is not enabled; no runtime behavior observation was performed.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动监听服务，只在宿主 Web 服务注册 API 路由；宿主默认无鉴权属生态固有风险，插件文档明示并可选令牌保护写操作与密钥接口。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a listening service itself; it only registers API routes on the host's Web service. The host's lack of authentication by default is an inherent ecosystem risk; the plugin docs explicitly state this and offer optional tokens to protect write operations and the key endpoint.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：插件名、版本、commit 与任务卡一致，bundle/client 声明正常，未发现仿冒名称。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: plugin name, version, commit, and task card match; bundle/client declarations are normal; no name spoofing found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：全树文件过危险执行、敏感路径、外联与注入模式；预扫 21 条命中逐条核实均为良性或误报。
summary.en: Static scan passed: all files in the tree were scanned for dangerous execution, sensitive paths, outbound connections, and injection patterns; all 21 pre-scan hits were verified one by one and are benign or false positives.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无异常外联；网络出口均为业务所需。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no abnormal outbound connections; all network egress is business-required.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与注入文本语义干净，无提示词注入；能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and injected text are semantically clean, with no prompt injection; capability declarations match actual behavior.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本任务未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox validation was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided for this task).

target.zh: dsh-mneme@0.7.0#d8a568b（monorepo 子目录 dsh-mneme，插件类型：memory 记忆插件）
target.en: dsh-mneme@0.7.0#d8a568b (monorepo subdirectory dsh-mneme, plugin type: memory)

limits.zh: 首次全量审计，无版本基线；src/ 为 lib/ 的同步分发副本（发布脚本维护），两者按同一代码面核查；大文件（客户端面板、存储、服务、梦境调度）以全树模式扫描加命中点精读覆盖，未逐行通读全部 133 个文件；docs 与 CHANGELOG 经模式扫描未见可疑内容；动态沙箱未启用，未做运行时行为观测；作者身份无平台核验标记。
limits.en: First full audit with no version baseline; src/ is a synchronized distribution copy of lib/ (maintained by the release script), both checked on the same code surface; large files (client panel, storage, services, dream scheduler) were covered by full-tree pattern scanning plus focused review of hits, not line-by-line reading of all 133 files; docs and CHANGELOG showed no suspicious content after pattern scanning; dynamic sandbox not enabled, no runtime behavior observation; author identity has no platform verification marker.
